lainepapp.title: Corrugated Cardboard
lainepapp.description: The foundation of all our packaging. We produce and supply corrugated cardboard in various flute profiles and wall configurations — single wall, double wall, and triple wall. Suitable for manufacturing, retail, and logistics.
lainepapp.applications: Packaging manufacturing, raw material supply, custom box production, retail and logistics
lainepapp.metaTitle: Corrugated Board – Single, Double & Triple Wall
lainepapp.metaDescription: Corrugated cardboard in single, double and triple wall, 1–5 mm thick. Brown or white liner, double-wall rolls in 1000 and 1600 mm widths.
lainepapp.body: Corrugated board is the foundation of all our packaging. We produce and supply it in several flute profiles and wall configurations (single, double and triple wall) for manufacturing, retail and logistics. The board is 1–5 mm thick, with a brown or white outer liner. Double-wall roll board is offered in 1000 mm and 1600 mm widths, and other dimensions and technical parameters can be agreed. Buy the board as raw material, or have us turn it into finished boxes.

transpordipakend.title: Transport Packaging
transpordipakend.description: Robust corrugated cardboard transport boxes designed for heavy-duty shipping and storage. Built to withstand the rigors of logistics while keeping contents pristine. Available in standard and custom dimensions from 1 piece.
transpordipakend.applications: Logistics and freight, warehousing, e-commerce shipping, industrial goods transport
transpordipakend.metaDescription: Durable corrugated boxes for shipping and storage. Standard sizes and custom dimensions from 1 piece. Made in Tõrvandi, Tartu County, Estonia.
transpordipakend.body: Transport packaging is the most common type of box: easy to fold, easy to seal. We make corrugated boxes that protect goods in logistics, warehousing, e-commerce shipping and industrial transport. Choose a standard size or a box made to your product's dimensions, available from a single piece. Not sure which construction you need? Our FEFCO catalogue helps you find the right box style, such as the classic 0201.

fleksotrukk.title: Flexo Print Packaging
fleksotrukk.description: High-quality flexographic printing on corrugated cardboard. Any print design for vivid retail presence and brand recognition. Ideal for companies that want packaging to communicate their brand as well as protect their product.
fleksotrukk.applications: Retail packaging, brand packaging, product presentation boxes, promotional packaging
fleksotrukk.metaDescription: Flexographic printing on corrugated board for branded retail, presentation and promotional packaging. Any print design, choice of construction.
fleksotrukk.body: Flexographic printing lets your packaging carry your brand as well as protect the product. We print on corrugated board, with any print design, for retail packaging, brand boxes, product presentation and promotional packaging. Layout and construction are flexible, and perforation can be added so that part of the pack can be removed. Tell us about your product and we will suggest a design.

kulmutatud-toodete-pakend.title: Frozen Product Packaging
kulmutatud-toodete-pakend.description: Moisture-resistant corrugated cardboard packaging specifically engineered for frozen and refrigerated products. Maintains structural integrity at low temperatures. Suitable for cold storage logistics and frozen food production.
kulmutatud-toodete-pakend.applications: Frozen food production, cold storage logistics, refrigerated goods transport, food industry
kulmutatud-toodete-pakend.metaDescription: Moisture-resistant corrugated packaging for frozen and chilled products, including frozen fish. For cold storage logistics and food production.
kulmutatud-toodete-pakend.body: Frozen and chilled goods need packaging that does not soften in the cold. This corrugated packaging is made from moisture-resistant material, so frozen products can be transported in refrigerated conditions and kept in deep-freeze storage while the box keeps its structural integrity. We have also made packaging for frozen fish; the material is chosen to suit your product. It suits food producers, cold storage logistics and the transport of chilled goods.

pizzakarbid.title: Pizza Boxes
pizzakarbid.description: Corrugated cardboard pizza boxes for restaurants and delivery services. Available in standard sizes and custom dimensions with optional flexo print branding.
pizzakarbid.applications: Pizzerias and restaurants, food delivery services, takeaway food packaging, catering
pizzakarbid.metaTitle: Pizza Boxes – Corrugated, Printed to Order
pizzakarbid.metaDescription: Corrugated pizza boxes for restaurants and delivery services. Standard and custom sizes, orders from 1 piece, any print.
pizzakarbid.body: Pizza boxes for restaurants and delivery services. We make them from corrugated board in standard sizes or custom dimensions. You can order from a single piece, and a trial order is possible. The box can carry your logo and brand design, with any print you need.

erilise-kujuga-pakendid.title: Custom Shape Packaging
erilise-kujuga-pakendid.description: Bespoke packaging developed specifically for your product's dimensions, shape and transportation conditions. Our CAD designers engineer die-cut solutions that balance protection with presentation. From fragile electronics to industrial components.
erilise-kujuga-pakendid.applications: Electronics and tech products, fragile or irregularly shaped items, industrial components, premium retail presentation
erilise-kujuga-pakendid.metaDescription: Custom corrugated packaging made to your product's dimensions and shipping conditions. CAD design, flat-bed and rotary die cutting, optional flexo print.
erilise-kujuga-pakendid.body: When a standard box does not fit, we develop packaging around your product: its dimensions, shape and transport conditions. Our CAD designers create die-cut solutions that combine protection with presentation, for fragile electronics, industrial components or premium retail packaging. We use flat-bed die cutting for large custom shapes and rotary die cutting for larger runs and smaller formats, and can add flexographic printing.

suuregabariidilised-pakendid.title: Large Format Packaging
suuregabariidilised-pakendid.description: Heavy-duty corrugated cardboard packaging for large or heavy goods. Engineered for oversized industrial products, furniture, appliances, and pallet transport. Built to handle substantial weight and volume without compromising structural integrity.
suuregabariidilised-pakendid.applications: Industrial equipment, furniture and appliances, pallet transport, construction materials
suuregabariidilised-pakendid.metaTitle: Large Corrugated Boxes for Heavy Goods
suuregabariidilised-pakendid.metaDescription: Heavy-duty corrugated containers for large and heavy goods: industrial equipment, furniture, appliances and pallet transport.
suuregabariidilised-pakendid.body: Large or heavy goods need packaging that holds its shape under load. Our corrugated containers are designed for oversized industrial products, furniture, appliances and pallet transport, with the sides joined with staples for strength. Tell us the size and weight of the product and we will propose the construction.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.body: This page describes how Tartupak processes personal data from website visitors and inquiry submissions.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: Tartu Pak OÜ (registry code 10739054), Tamme 35, Tõrvandi alevik, Ülenurme vald, 61715 Tartumaa, Estonia.

sections.heading: 2. What data we process
paragraphs: When you send a quote request through the contact form, we receive:
items: name, company, e-mail address and phone number;
packaging type, dimensions, quantity and your message;
for security: your IP address is processed by the hosting and bot-protection services when you use the site and the form.
paragraphsAfter: If you accept cookies, we and Google also process analytics and advertising data: pages viewed, device and browser information, the campaign or ad you came from, and click identifiers (such as UTM parameters and Google click ID). If you decline, none of this is collected.

sections.heading: 3. Why we process it
items: To reply to your inquiry and prepare a quote (steps at your request and our legitimate interest in running our business).
To keep the site and the form secure and to block bots (legitimate interest).
To measure site traffic and the performance of our advertising (your consent, which you can withdraw at any time).

sections.heading: 4. Who receives the data
paragraphs: We use the following service providers, who process data on our behalf or as independent controllers:
items: Resend (delivery of the e-mail containing your inquiry);
Cloudflare Turnstile (bot protection on the contact form);
Google (Tag Manager, Analytics, Ads) — only if you accept cookies.
paragraphsAfter: Some of these providers are located outside the European Economic Area. Transfers are based on an adequacy decision of the European Commission or standard contractual clauses. We do not sell personal data.

sections.heading: 5. How long we keep it
paragraphs: Inquiries are kept for as long as needed to handle them, to maintain any resulting business relationship and to meet legal obligations. Analytics data in Google Analytics is kept for 14 months; advertising data is kept according to the retention settings of Google Ads.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and similar technologies
items: Essential: language preference and bot protection on the contact form. These are needed for the site to work.
Your cookie choice is stored in your browser (local storage).
Optional, only with your consent: Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics and Google Ads, used to measure visits and advertising results.
paragraphsAfter: You can change or withdraw your choice at any time using “Cookie settings” in the footer.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your data, correct it, have it erased, restrict or object to processing, receive it in a portable format, and withdraw consent at any time. To exercise these rights write to info@tartupak.ee.
You may also lodge a complaint with the Estonian Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon, www.aki.ee).

terms.body: Terms of use of the Tartupak website: information on the site, quote requests, intellectual property and liability.

sections.heading: 2. Information on the website
paragraphs: Product descriptions, specifications, images and FEFCO diagrams are provided for general information and may change without notice. They are not a binding offer.
The actual product parameters, prices and delivery terms are agreed separately in a written offer or contract.

sections.heading: 3. Quote requests
paragraphs: Submitting the contact form does not create a contract. We will reply to your request and may ask for additional information. A contract is concluded only after both parties have confirmed the terms in writing.
We process personal data as described in our Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual property

paragraphsAfter: The FEFCO name and codes belong to their respective owners and are shown here for reference only.

sections.heading: 5. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You must not use the website in a way that:
items: breaches the law or the rights of third parties;
disrupts the website or its servers, including excessive automated requests;

sections.heading: 6. Availability and liability
paragraphs: We aim to keep the website available and the information accurate, but we do not guarantee uninterrupted operation or error-free content. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for damage arising from the use of the website or from reliance on the information on it, except where liability cannot be excluded by law.

sections.heading: 7. External links

sections.heading: 8. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is published on this page together with the date of the last update.

sections.heading: 9. Governing law and contact
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Estonia. We try to resolve disputes through negotiation; failing that, they are resolved by the competent Estonian court.
